frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Time-series regression of fund excess return on factor excess returns yields the intercept alpha (Jensen 1-factor, Carhart 4-factor, Fung-Hsieh 7-factor); quadratic/option timing terms split timing from selectivity, conditional betas vary with public information, and Roll (1978) shows benchmark choice makes alpha ambiguous.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Multifactor Alpha, Market Timing, and Conditional Models
